{{Quote|No, it's okay, Sarge. I've got nothing to hide.|Gus|audio=GusNothingToHide-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
'''Gus''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who was a member of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the war's [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]], Gus was part of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led detachment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that was tasked with [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberating]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After helping [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] find a strategic ambush site on-world, Gus and his comrades prepared to ambush the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, the Separatists thwarted their ambush, injuring Gus and forcing him and the others to retreat to their [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]], where a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] treated him. When [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] interrogated the members of Slick's platoon to apprehend a possible Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]], Gus stated his alibi without hesitation. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick himself was thereafter revealed to be the traitor and was detained.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was in the infirmary. Got banged up pretty good by one of those clankers. Med droid was fixing me up. Doc's got all the records there, if you want to check.|Gus, to Cody and Rex|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] nicknamed Gus<ref name="TCWCE" /> was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="DB clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Gus was assigned to [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="Official Episode Guide: Season 1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the seventh [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the war,<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Gus joined a contingent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]]&mdash;led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Slick's [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] reconnoitered the planet and located a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|double-towered business center]] as a suitable site from which to ambush the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. As they returned to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic base]], the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] came across a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that were attempting to clear a major boulevard of [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. When the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] discovered a crippled Christophsian and discussed [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, the clones intervened and eradicated the droids before returning to their base.<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>

[[File:Gus_cannon.png|thumb|left|240px|Gus reports progress on setting up the cannon to Slick and Cody.]]
[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick's platoon was stationed in the business center's south-facing tower with [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], while Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] became based out of the parallel north tower with their [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. The Republic soldiers prepared to attack the Confederate droids as they passed through the plaza below, and Gus assisted several of his comrades in setting up a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] before monitoring the droids' progress with a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]]. Gus noted that the droids had brought [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] but then noticed that the approaching droid column had unexpectedly split in two. Immediately thereafter, battle droids arrived in the south tower and [[Ground warfare/Legends|ambushed]] Gus and the others, and Gus sustained an injury in the ensuing battle. Skywalker and his men arrived in the south tower to reinforce Kenobi's detachment, and the group took a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the roof of the tower. Before escaping with the Republic forces in [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]],<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Gus stole the cranial unit of<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> [[TJ-55/Legends|TJ-55]],<ref name="Complete Season One">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]]</ref> the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] commanding the enemy troops, so that more information about the droid ambush could be gathered.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

After returning to the Republic base alongside his comrades, Gus visited the infirmary, where a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] treated his wound. During an investigation into the possibility of a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] within their ranks, CC-2224 and CT-7567&mdash;nicknamed "Cody" and "Rex," respectively&mdash;tracked an irregular wavelength in external communications to Slick's [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], leading them to suspect that one of Slick's men was the enemy agent. As a result, they called the platoon back to the barracks to individually question the troopers. During Rex and Cody's interrogation, Gus stated he had nothing to hide and did not hesitate to voice his alibi of being in the infirmary. When fellow trooper [[Chopper (clone trooper)/Legends|Chopper]] revealed that he had lied about his whereabouts and had been breaking war protocols by stringing together battle droid [[Limb/Legends|fingers]] in a necklace, Gus commented on his deficiency. However, Slick was thereafter revealed to be the spy, and he escaped before severely damaging the Republic's [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]], and weapons depot.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Gus spotted Slick running into the base's command center,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> and Rex and Cody ordered Slick's platoon to secure the perimeter while they apprehended the traitorous sergeant.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I always knew there was something ''deficient'' about you.|Gus, to Chopper|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
[[File:Gus_alibi.png|thumb|right|250px|Gus explains that he was in the infirmary, proving his alibi.]]
A Human male, Gus stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. He had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and kept his black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] shaved.<ref name="TCWCE" /> While being questioned by Rex and Cody, he did not hesitate to state his alibi, believing that he had nothing to hide. When Chopper revealed he had been stringing droid fingers together in a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]], Gus voiced his belief that his fellow trooper was deficient. In addition, he was visibly shocked when his own sergeant, Slick, was revealed to be the Confederate spy.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Gus chose to sport a rakish goatee and kept it carefully tended. He was trained in combat, [[Scout/Legends|recon]], and military tactics on Kamino.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gus first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shadowed|''Shadowed'']] and went on to appear in "[[The Hidden Enemy]]," the episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]]' [[2008]]&ndash;[[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] that the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] led into. In the episode, Gus was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provided the voice for all of the series' clone trooper characters.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" />
